_comment: NSE equity-segment (Capital Market) trading holidays for 2026. Weekend dates need not be listed. Taken from NSE circular NSE/CMTR/71775 (Ref. 172/2025, 12 Dec 2025, 'Trading Holidays for Calendar Year 2026', 15 weekday holidays) and NSE/CMTR/72260 (12 Jan 2026, which added 2026-01-15). The circulars were read through search-index extracts of the NSE PDFs, checked by two independent searches on 2026-10-19, but not opened directly: this environment cannot reach nseindia.com. Open nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/CMTR71775.pdf, check the table, then set verified_on. Muhurat trading 2026: Sunday 2026-11-08, timings to be notified by a later circular (a weekend session; the system does not trade it). The 2027 list was not yet published on 2026-10-19.
source: NSE circulars NSE/CMTR/71775 (2025-12-12) and NSE/CMTR/72260 (2026-01-12), via search-index extracts; not opened directly

holidays.2026-01-15: Municipal Corporation Election in Maharashtra (added by NSE/CMTR/72260)
holidays.2026-11-24: Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev
